seeds.paraphrase: Eorlund turned his back on the Emperor, ending our friendship.
Vignar scorns my loyalty to the Empire and threatens my family when the Stormcloaks take Whiterun.
Olfrid threatens to seize my property through the Thalmor; his money will not protect him forever.
Olfrid mocks Thorald's disappearance and threatens me. I need to know where my son is.
Idolaf tells me to accept Thorald's loss. I believe my son lives and want the truth.
Ulfric killed Torygg and his rebellion makes Skyrim suffer. I want this war ended and justice for my husband.
Vaermina torments Dawnstar with nightmares. I must end her hold on its people.
I defy Molag Bal by dedicating his altar to Boethiah. He has failed to stop me before.
Mikael boasts that he will conquer me. I want him to leave me alone so I can raise my daughter.
Braith demands my money and threatens to hit me. I want her to stop bullying me.
